value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete natural-family classification directly motivated by the finite-space Whitehead problem. It identifies the exact quotient of order data visible to weak homotopy and supplies systematic non-homotopy-equivalent cores with identical weak type. This is structural rather than a routine parameter substitution, and the singleton boundary completes the classification.
